definitions.explanation: The blank space on a form, contract, or delivery slip where the person signs their name. Also used of the signature box in an email or on a web form.

examples.japanese: {署名欄|しょめいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write your name in the signature field.

examples.japanese: {署名欄|しょめいらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|あ}いた→空く：11062_aku⟧ままだった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{返|かえ}された→返す：09648_kaesu⟧。
examples.english: The signature field was left blank, so the document was sent back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧{署名欄|しょめいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In the signature field on the last page of the contract, please also fill in the date and your address.

notes:
⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧ (signature) + ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, field on a form). The suffix ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ names any labeled blank on a document: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (address field), ⟦{備考|びこう}{欄|らん}→備考欄：17222_bikouran⟧ (remarks field).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fill in the signature field
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サインする→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧: to sign in the signature field
- {署名欄|しょめいらん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧: the signature field is blank

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{捺印欄|なついんらん}→捺印欄：30150_natsuinran⟧: seal field — the space for a personal seal, which many Japanese documents require instead of or alongside a signature
- ⟦{記入欄|きにゅうらん}→記入欄：21276_kinyuuran⟧: entry field — any blank to be filled in, not specifically for a name
